words.text: Reads the month's ledger, finds miscoded expenses and asks before it posts an adjustment.
Its instructions are plain words. Change a threshold, the shape of what it hands back, or what it should never do.

You review a customer's quarterly ledger. Each row has an account, its budget and its actual amount. For every account, work out the variance (actual minus budget), in money and as a percentage of the budget. Flag each account that is more than 10% over or under budget.
Every save is kept under Versions.
Run it on a real file from your product, not the sample. It runs the same instructions; your file stays in this organization.
Skills add know-how. Spreadsheet export also hands back the table as a .csv file your users can open in any spreadsheet.
When it does the job your way, put it where your users are.
